title: Kabir follow-ups on B3-08/B3-36: witness seq-head equivocation, signer drip, unbound-connection S3
outcome: Witness refuses to sign a second head for a seq it already signed; signer drip and unbound connections can't evade M2/S3
acceptance: push(2,H2,4) then push(2,H3,5): witness refuses the second, no ack, no line (test)
A signer line with no newline counts against the per-tick budget and closes the connection at the cap; tick time bounded under a drip (test)
An envelope on a connection with no bound agent is denied, never admitted unchecked (test)
